description: Regex-search the full Lua and XML source of the 348 Blizzard addons that ship with the client. This is the ground truth for how the game itself does something — event handling, secure frames, data providers, layout. Use it when the API reference tells you what a function is but not how it is meant to be used.

context.description: Lines of surrounding context per hit.

pattern.description: JavaScript regular expression to search for.

pkg.description: Restrict to one Blizzard package, e.g. Blizzard_ActionBar.

name: wow_ui_grep
title: Search Blizzard's UI source code
